name: Translate to Ukrainian
description: The computer voice speaks what you say in Ukrainian. Needs live voice-to-speech. Downloads a 120 MB translation model once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Ukrainian model from the Argos Translate package index: Argos Translate (Argos Open Technologies), released under MIT or CC0 (argos-translate issue #533). Trained on OPUS data; includes a Stanza English tokenizer (Apache-2.0).
